description: SedSim is a daily mass-balance model for reservoir networks, sediment transport and hydropower. It represents reservoir designs and sediment-management policies in an Excel VBA implementation. The provider is FeralFlows. Coverage: The model is generic to user-specified river basins and operates at a daily time step. Dates and spatial network detail are supplied through model inputs. Access: The public repository documents a macro-enabled workbook, XLS inputs and XLS/CSV outputs. No workbook was downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The repository identifies the BSD 2-Clause licence. Required software and external input data have separate conditions. Limitations: This is a screening mass-balance model, not a fine-scale sediment-transport solver. The README establishes publications and reuse, but no simulations were checked here. For simulation it supports comparison of reservoir siting, design and operating policies. Related resources: SedSim and PySedSim are distinct VBA and Python implementations. Neither has an existing catalogue record identified in this review.
